item.title: Implementing a reverb VST with JUCE
item.description:
Background

When something I’ve always wanted to do ends up being taught in a class, it feels so good.

In the course Analysis of Digital Music Signal in NCKU, each group of students used JUCE (a C++ framework for making VSTs) to build a VST effect. Our group made a reverb. The purpose of reverb is to add echoes to music, creating the feeling of being in a cathedral or concert hall.
